name: D'Avenant
description: A matriarchal order of warriors from Avenant on Dominaria, ruled by the Suzeraine and composed of its most talented archers.

description_citations.text: "Order of the D'Avenant". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A D'Avenant proverb says healing depends on time and opportunity.
timeline.quote: "Healing is a matter of time, but it is sometimes also a matter of opportunity."

citation.text: Alabaster Potion (Rivals Quick Start Set, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: An Archer but not a Knight.
relations.quote: Élan d'Avenant was a member of the order, an Archer but not a Knight.
